topic: AI campaign roadmap and presentation updates
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on updating the roadmap and presentation materials for AI capabilities. It was decided that a new section, titled "AI challenges," would be added to the existing dashboard slide or as a separate subsequent slide. This section should include examples of questions users can ask via the AI Dashboard.

[me] provided an example of internal security pre-prompts designed to prevent prompt injection attacks for inclusion in the presentation materials.

Regarding the overall presentation, it was suggested that the team's content be placed last, starting with a slide emphasizing the necessity and unique value proposition of their work relative to other departments (Data + Operations + IT).
decisions: Add an 'AI challenges' section/slide to the dashboard or presentation.
The AI Dashboard slide should include examples of user questions for AI functionality.
The team's presentation content will be placed last in a larger, combined departmental presentation.
action_items: [me] needs to finalize and add the 'AI challenges' section/slide with example questions.
Someone needs to incorporate the provided security pre-prompt examples into the presentation.
